products.title: Neovolt Product Catalog
products.subtitle: Bytewatt-certified energy storage systems — single-phase residential at three-phase commercial.
products.singlePhaseIntro: Para sa mga tahanan at maliit na commercial spaces. 230Vac, 60Hz Philippine grid compatible. Zero-export mode standard — hindi kailangan ng net metering permit.
products.threePhaseIntro: Para sa hotels, offices, clinics, at commercial buildings. 400Vac three-phase. Hanggang 15kW output. Parallel-capable hanggang 6 units.
products.batteriesIntro: Lahat ng batteries ay gumagamit ng EVE Tier 1 prismatic LiFePO4 cells. 10-taong warranty. 8,000+ cycle life. Cebu tropical climate rated (−10 hanggang +60°C).
products.bundlesSubtitle: Pre-engineered system packages para sa karaniwang gamit.

about.title: Tungkol sa OptiCore Energy Solutions
about.subtitle: Cebu-based solar + ESS integrator na naglilingkod sa Eastern Visayas.
about.founderBio: Ang OptiCore Energy Solutions ay itinatag upang punan ang kakulangan sa Cebu market — ang kawalan ng locally based, licensed engineer na nag-aalok ng end-to-end solar at ESS design, installation, at after-sales support. Bilang Registered Mechanical Engineer na nag-specialize sa mechanical at electrical systems, si Julius Gisto ay nagdadala ng engineering-grade precision sa bawat proyekto, mula initial load analysis hanggang commissioning at warranty registration.
about.cred1: Registered Mechanical Engineer (RME) — Professional Regulation Commission
about.cred2: Technical Background: Mechanical & Electrical Systems, Energy Audit, CAD
about.cred3: Specialty: Solar PV design, ESS sizing, Philippine grid interconnection
about.cred4: Location: Cebu City — naglilingkod sa Cebu, Bohol, at Eastern Visayas
about.partner1Role: Lead Installation Partner — Cebu at Bohol
about.partner1Bio: Registered Mechanical Engineer na may hands-on hybrid inverter at solar panel installation experience. Namumuno sa isang certified crew.
about.partner2Role: Independent Regional Partner — Leyte at Eastern Visayas
about.partner2Bio: Aldrean T. Polistico, ECE/ECT. Licensed Electronics Engineer at Technician na may TESDA NCII Solar PV certification. Established solar installation business na may kumpletong residential at commercial projects sa buong Region VIII.
about.mission: Ang misyon ng OptiCore ay gawing accessible sa mga Pilipinong tahanan at negosyo ang maaasahan at professionally engineered solar at battery storage — may transparent na presyo, matapat na engineering, at lokal na support na maaabot mo.
